_note: Character voice direction taken from the universe bible. 'openai_voice' and 'elevenlabs_voice_id' are starting points: audition them and replace. ElevenLabs ids below are placeholders you must fill in from your own voice library.

MARY.direction: Mature warm alto, Levantine cadence, unhurried and measured, velvety midrange with a slight rasp-ache, slow steady pacing, soft consonant accent. Already grieved and choosing to speak anyway. Intimate, as if remembering aloud.

PETER.direction: Male, late 50s, low tenor, rough gravel-timbred, blunt. Slow-to-moderate pace, quick to rise in volume when threatened or defensive. Neutral accent.

ANDREW.direction: Young adult male, reedy tenor, nervous cadence, quick and clipped when unsettled, light breathy timbre, clear enunciation.

LEVI.direction: Adult male, low-key baritone, even pitch, warm resonant timbre, deliberate and steady. Gains quiet firmness only when he finally speaks up.

SAVIOUR.direction: Warm, unhurried, measured male voice, apparent age 45-55, medium-low pitch, smooth velvety texture, steady slow pace, mild neutral accent. Gentle authority, never theatrical.
